video.title: AI欧腐《他认错了爱人/He Loved the Wrong Brother》
video.desc:
哥们不仅眼瞎 耳朵也聋
He Loved the Wrong Brother Jasper Hawthorne was a powerful heir to a luxury fragrance empire. After a devastating accident, he lost his eyesight and everything he once had. When the world abandoned him, Kieran Moren stayed. For two years, Kieran became his eyes, his support, and the only person who brought him back to life. In the darkness, Jasper learned to love the man who saved him. But when Jasper finally regained his sight, he made the cruelest mistake. Killian Moren, his half-brother, stole Kieran’s identity and claimed the two years of devotion as his own. Unable to see the truth, Jasper chose the wrong person. He lost the only man who truly loved him. And by the time he discovered the truth, it was already too late.
Jasper Hawthorne 是奢华香水帝国权势显赫的继承人。一场毁灭性的意外夺走了他的视力，也让他失去了曾经拥有的一切。
当全世界都抛弃他时，只有 Kieran Moren 留了下来。
整整两年，Kieran 成为 Jasper 的双眼、支柱，也是唯一一个将他从绝望中重新带回人间的人。在漫长的黑暗里，Jasper 渐渐爱上了这个拯救自己的男人。
然而，当 Jasper 终于重见光明时，他却犯下了最残忍、也最无法挽回的错误。
Kieran 的异母兄弟 Killian Moren 冒用了他的身份，将 Kieran 两年来的陪伴、付出与深情全部据为己有。没能看清真相的 Jasper 选择了错误的人，也亲手失去了那个真正爱着他的男人。
等到他终于发现真相时，一切都已经太迟了。
